title: ElevenIQ contract v1: shared definitions
description: Shared parts of contract 1.0.0 (ADR 005 §2). Every number is computed in Python and ships with its display text; the site never computes a statistic. Floats are rounded to 6 decimals. Text fields come from the words table (export/words.py, registry.REASON_TEXT / NOTE_TEXT).

rowKey.description: <player_id>-<team_id>-<competition_id>-<season_id>: ids only, never a name (plan 006 decision 9).

stamps.description: The provenance of the export, repeated in every file. No wall-clock time: two exports of the same data are byte-identical.

noteText.description: short: for a table cell; full: for its popover (DESIGN decision 7).

bin.description: DESIGN.md §4 colour bin of the direction-adjusted percentile: 0 (≤ 10), 1 (< 40), 2 (40–60), 3 (< 90), 4 (≥ 90); "uncoloured" for style metrics, long pass completion and cells associated with team possession; null without a percentile.

scope.description: One percentile scope (local: league × group; global: group across the pool leagues). pct is the shown percentile (0–100): the stored Hazen percentile, direction-adjusted for a lower-better metric (100 − p; W0 decision 1), so number, phrase, bar and bin agree; pct_text is ">99" / "<1" for rows outside their population, else half-up 1–99; a null pct shows status_text instead.

band.description: The fixed band of the shown percentile (Top 1% … Bottom 5%; style metrics: Higher than most / Around average / Lower than most). It replaces the number in every cell.

note.description: The exact number for the popover, e.g. "97th percentile among Premier League 2015/16 central midfielders".

population_text.description: "n 64 of 157 STs with ≥ 43 long passes" for a ratio, else "n 157".

metricRow.description: The row facts of one metric; its shared facts are in groups/<group>.json at the same index (registry metric order).

value_text.description: Percent with 1 decimal for shares and _pct metrics, 3 decimals for ratios, else 2; "—" when null.

total_text.description: The season total ("176 total") or a ratio's made / attempted counts ("1,812 / 2,215"), from the season parquet; null on second-group rows.

zero_tie.description: A zero in a zero-heavy cell (the registry's reason, or a measured zero share above the registry's threshold): "tied at zero, not a rank" instead of a percentile. A signature trait shows no percentile in the metric rows (holder / non-holder, ADR 004 §11.5).
